seo_title: Malaysian Food Stories & Cultural Heritage | Simply Enak
seo_description: The stories behind Malaysian food culture—family recipes passed down through generations, the vendors who have cooked one dish for fifty years, and the heritage that shapes every meal.
hero_subtitle: Where food meets culture, history, and the people who keep traditions alive
section_vendor_body: The real stars of Malaysian cuisine aren't chefs. They're the aunties and uncles who have perfected one dish over a lifetime.
section_insider_body: How to eat like a local, find the stalls worth queuing for, and read the history sitting right there on your plate.
section_culture_body: The festivals, traditions, and communities that shape what you taste and who you meet on our tours.
section_values_body: For 14+ years, we've been more than tour operators. We're your temporary neighbours, committed to sustainability, fair compensation, and cultural preservation.
newsletter_body: Get the latest food stories, vendor profiles, and tour news. No spam — just what's worth reading from Malaysia.

translations.seo_title: Cerita Makanan Malaysia & Warisan Budaya | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Kisah di sebalik budaya makanan Malaysia — resipi keluarga yang diwarisi turun-temurun, penjual yang memasak satu hidangan selama lima puluh tahun, dan warisan yang membentuk setiap hidangan.
translations.hero_subtitle: Di mana makanan bertemu budaya, sejarah, dan orang-orang yang menghidupkan tradisi

translations.seo_title: 马来西亚美食故事与文化遗产 | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: 马来西亚饮食文化背后的故事——代代相传的家族食谱、五十年如一日烹制同一道菜的摊贩，以及塑造每一餐的文化遗产。
translations.hero_subtitle: 美食与文化、历史和守护传统的人们相遇之处

translations.seo_title: Malaysische Food-Geschichten & Kulturelles Erbe | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Die Geschichten hinter Malaysias Esskultur — Familienrezepte, die über Generationen weitergegeben wurden, Händler, die seit fünfzig Jahren dasselbe Gericht kochen, und das Erbe, das jede Mahlzeit prägt.
translations.hero_subtitle: Wo Essen auf Kultur, Geschichte und die Menschen trifft, die Traditionen lebendig halten

translations.seo_title: Historias de Comida Malaya y Patrimonio Cultural | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Las historias detrás de la cultura gastronómica de Malasia — recetas familiares transmitidas por generaciones, vendedores que han cocinado el mismo plato durante cincuenta años, y el patrimonio que da forma a cada comida.
translations.hero_subtitle: Donde la comida se encuentra con la cultura, la historia y las personas que mantienen vivas las tradiciones

translations.seo_title: Histoires de Cuisine Malaisienne et Patrimoine Culturel | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Les histoires derrière la culture culinaire malaisienne — des recettes familiales transmises de génération en génération, des vendeurs qui cuisinent le même plat depuis cinquante ans, et le patrimoine qui façonne chaque repas.
translations.hero_subtitle: Là où la nourriture rencontre la culture, l'histoire et les gens qui gardent les traditions vivantes

translations.seo_title: Maleisische Foodverhalen & Cultureel Erfgoed | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: De verhalen achter de Maleisische eetcultuur — familierecipes die door generaties zijn doorgegeven, verkopers die al vijftig jaar hetzelfde gerecht koken, en het erfgoed dat elke maaltijd vormgeeft.
translations.hero_subtitle: Waar eten cultuur, geschiedenis en de mensen die tradities levend houden ontmoet

translations.seo_title: Истории Малайзийской Кухни и Культурное Наследие | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Истории за малайзийской кулинарной культурой — семейные рецепты, передающиеся из поколения в поколение, продавцы, готовящие одно блюдо пятьдесят лет, и наследие, формирующее каждый приём пищи.
translations.hero_subtitle: Там, где еда встречается с культурой, историей и людьми, хранящими традиции

translations.seo_title: マレーシア料理の物語と文化遺産 | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: マレーシアの食文化の背景にある物語――代々受け継がれる家族のレシピ、50年間同じ料理を作り続ける屋台の主人、そして毎食を形づくる文化遺産。
translations.hero_title: マレーシア料理の物語
translations.hero_subtitle: 食が文化、歴史、そして伝統を守り続ける人々と出会う場所

translations.seo_title: Histórias de Comida Malaia e Património Cultural | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: As histórias por detrás da cultura gastronómica malaia — receitas de família transmitidas de geração em geração, vendedores que cozinham o mesmo prato há cinquenta anos, e o património que molda cada refeição.
translations.hero_subtitle: Onde a comida encontra a cultura, a história e as pessoas que mantêm as tradições vivas
